status: rejected at matched clay/PBR visual gate; dense source retained as quality authority
coordinates: Blender Z-up authoring; glTF +Y up; metres

derivation.path: direct dense donor; rejected 90k transfer/bake path is archived

fit.method: linear width fit; edge-protected cubic depth fit with front/back local scale equal to the width scale; piecewise vertical fit around the sampled landing datum

simplification.method: Blender collapse decimation with weighted detail protection

protection.method: Protect high-curvature vertices plus the lower ornament, front/back arches, end architecture and raised rim/foliage; concentrate collapse on broad low-curvature slab surfaces.
protection.authoredWeightSemantics: Higher authored weights mark protected detail. The Decimate modifier inverts this group so protected vertices receive low effective collapse weights and broad planar vertices receive high effective collapse weights.

landingFlattenBeforeSimplification.method: Flatten only vertices on broad upward-facing remesh polygons inside the exact 1.70 x 1.30 metre landing and within 6cm of the sampled datum; preserve UVs, silhouette geometry, ornament and the exposed donor artwork.

landingFlattenAfterSimplification.method: Flatten only vertices on broad upward-facing remesh polygons inside the exact 1.70 x 1.30 metre landing and within 6cm of the sampled datum; preserve UVs, silhouette geometry, ornament and the exposed donor artwork.

runtimeGeometry.budgetRationale: The 238,000-triangle direct derivative is retained for the quality trial because it avoids the failed remesh projection and protects foliage, arches, medallions, legs and silhouette while simplifying broad slab regions.

normalFinalization.method: Rebuild split normals from simplified geometric vertex normals; use exact +Z on fully flattened contact polygons and the polygon face normal whenever a smoothed candidate leaves the geometric hemisphere.

uvSingularityRepair.method: Give only decimator-created zero-area UV triangles a loop-local perpendicular half-pixel footprint before tangent generation; geometry and all other UVs unchanged.

repairs.islandContinuity: Shares the longest geometric edge with the recorded non-degenerate neighbor; the half-pixel footprint uses matching winding and remains inside the provider atlas padding adjacent to that island edge.

preExportTangentRepair.method: Replace only singular corner normals with the corresponding polygon normal, then regenerate tangent space; positions, indices and UVs remain unchanged.

preExportResidualTangentPolicy.acceptedScope: exactly 7 rows mapped to 6 diagnosed valid-UV sliver polygons
preExportResidualTangentPolicy.exportRepair: final exported POSITION/UV/NORMAL/indices differential basis; no arbitrary axis and no full-Mikk-continuity claim

boundedLocalSliverRepair.proposedMethod: Collapse one disjoint, manifold, same-material, provider-atlas-contiguous edge no longer than 5 mm per diagnosed geometric sliver.

failure.message: Geometric sliver 182387 has no disjoint manifold, UV-contiguous, same-material collapse edge at or below 5 mm

boundedLocalSliverRepair.decision: Do not widen the distance, seam, manifold, material, or disjointness bounds and do not retry topology tuning. Preserve the 238000-triangle geometry and use the separately validated analytic UV-derivative tangent construction only for the seven exported zero tangent rows.

baseColor4k.method: byte-identical copy of provider source base color

normal4k.method: byte-identical copy of provider source tangent normal

channels.red: neutral occlusion constant 255; provider supplied no AO map

normal2k.method: Lanczos3 resize followed by per-texel tangent-vector renormalization

tangentAndOcclusionPatch.method: Post-export float64 per-triangle UV derivative, Gram-Schmidt projection against the final exported split normal, and handedness from the corresponding bitangent.
tangentAndOcclusionPatch.scope: Only the seven zero TANGENT rows mapped by geometry-area and UV-determinant to the six diagnosed nondegenerate sliver polygons.
